unresolved.label: Israel / Israeli

unresolved.label: Palestine / Palestinian
unresolved.answer: There is no separate Palestinian component. Middle Eastern or North African fitted shares cannot be relabeled as a Palestinian percentage, and an unresolved label does not exclude family origins there.
unresolved.relationship: bigsnpr composition-model reference scope; separate from GrafAnc category definitions.

unresolved.label: Iraq / Iraqi
unresolved.answer: Iraqi-born participants are a major part of the Middle Eastern reference, alongside Iranian and other participants. Iraq and Iran are not estimated separately.
unresolved.relationship: bigsnpr composition-model reference scope; separate from GrafAnc category definitions.

unresolved.label: Iran / Iranian
unresolved.answer: Iranian-born participants are included in the Middle Eastern reference. This is a combined reference estimate rather than an Iranian-only or Persian-identity percentage.
unresolved.relationship: bigsnpr composition-model reference scope; separate from GrafAnc category definitions.

unresolved.label: Pakistan / Pakistani
unresolved.answer: The model includes an explicitly named Pakistani reference component. Its estimate describes fit to that study group; it does not separately identify every community in Pakistan or prove nationality.
unresolved.relationship: bigsnpr composition-model reference scope; separate from GrafAnc category definitions.

unresolved.label: Ashkenazi Jewish
unresolved.answer: This composition model includes an explicit Ashkenazi diaspora reference component. Its estimated share is a genetic model result, not a test of religious belief or community membership. Small fitted shares can shift between nearby reference groups.
unresolved.relationship: bigsnpr composition-model reference scope; separate from GrafAnc category definitions.

unresolved.label: Khazar
unresolved.answer: No Khazar reference component is defined. An Ashkenazi, Middle Eastern or ancient Steppe/Caucasus comparison cannot be converted into a claim of descent from the historical Khazar polity.
unresolved.relationship: bigsnpr composition-model reference scope; separate from GrafAnc category definitions.

place_context.boundary: Places describe this model's published reference membership. Country-of-birth metadata are not separate inherited country shares. A fitted component is relative to the included genetic references; unsupported origins may be redistributed, and unresolved labels do not mean family origins are absent.
